question: In the whole history each registered law makes from each supplied start, how does the number of knots within r holder steps of a knot grow with r, read exactly from the counts; does any run give the same power from every knot examined, with two-sided bounds on a common range that lengthens with the rounds; what does the roster at one round read, kept apart from the history; and on the growing end, does how strongly two members' loose distinctions are related keep the order of how soon their descendants meet, and how much of any breaking goes with the members' own loose counts and shared places?
inputs: The census starts, the named starts and hand-built controls, the laws, the knots counted from, the weightings, the seeds, the bounds and the guard named in the pre-registration and its data files; this study's definitions and claim; the definitions of PARTS-MEET-AGAIN-20261124-001 and the shared definitions of RING-IN-BALANCE-20261123-001; the engine of PARTS-MEET-AGAIN-20261124-001A, unchanged, read-only.
forbidden_inputs: Any definition changed after a value is seen; for the engine's author, the drafter's scratch prototype and anything it produced beyond what the pre-registration discloses; any change to the frozen engine; any reading of a power not registered; any knot counted from that is chosen after its counts are seen.
primary_observable: For every registered run: the count of knots within r holder steps from every knot examined, in the whole history, on its kept range, with its exact reading (a polynomial on a range, a linear recurrence, a ratio, or undecided) and its two-sided bounds; births per round read the same way; the roster's count per part at stated rounds, kept apart; the gate (the same power from every knot examined on a common range, at two numbers of rounds) with the spread of the bounds; the start-by-start table of readings across laws; under the taking rules, the knot count against the greatest holder steps with the swaps of the step; on the growing end, the concordant, discordant and tied comparisons per stage in three nested strata, under each reading; the knot test where registered.
comparators_or_controls: Hand-built controls with known counts (a ring, a structure with no cycles in which each knot meets three, a six-regular weave, a comb that must fail the gate); the fixed ration of three from one knot; the ordinary count with retiring and caps of two, three and four, to separate the cap from the treatment; parent steps and steps limited or weighted by holders as swaps of the step; the doubling reading as the swap of the exact reading; a shuffle reference for the order test, named for what it is.
resource_budget: Each run sized from measured rates to finish within the hour on at most 6 processes, each under a memory cap, about two and a half hours in all, run in the registered order; a run that would pass an hour is cut to a prefix fixed before it starts and what was not run is reported as not run. Bounds of rounds and knots as the definitions give them.
first_executable_signal: The hand-built controls read as known and the comb fails the gate; the checks of the three lemmas and of integer arithmetic pass; then the full gate on the named starts and the census sample.
decision_rule: Each prediction is judged by its 'Fails when' entry; checks of the code, replications of the scratch runs, arguments and reported readings are marked as such. A reading is a power only by the exact reading or the two-sided bound on its registered range; 'undecided' is its own verdict.
stop_rule: Stop when every registered run is done in its registered order or cut to a registered prefix, and every prediction and every one of the claim's questions has an answer among its registered exclusive answers, with the numbers undecided stated.
nonclaims: An exploratory study of finite counts. The count of knots within reach is a count of the growth's whole history, not of what exists at one round: from a start knot it is, within a fixed shift, the record's count of knots by round, and a power read over a roster of fixed size is one from the rounds. No limit object is defined, the count depends on the knot counted from, and an exponent without uniform two-sided bounds is not a dimension. The laws, starts, steps, weightings and bounds are supplied. No claim about physical space or time, living things or minds.
